name: application-schedule-agenda-list
title: Schedule Agenda List
description: Conference-style agenda grouped under a day heading, with each session row showing time, title, speaker(s), and a colored track badge.
useWhen: Displaying a conference, summit, or multi-track event schedule for a single day.
You need to convey track (Engineering, Design, Main Stage) via a colored badge alongside time and speaker.
Distinct from Itinerary Timeline, which shows a multi-day travel itinerary with per-activity-type icons (flight, hotel, tour) rather than speaker/track conference metadata.
avoidWhen: Showing a personal travel itinerary spanning flights, hotels, and activities — use Itinerary Timeline instead.
The schedule has no track/category distinction — a simpler time-ordered list may suffice.
responsiveBehavior: Time stays in a fixed-width left column so session titles align vertically across rows regardless of title length.
accessibility: Track is conveyed by both a text label and a color, never color alone.
Non-session rows like breaks are visually de-emphasized via muted text rather than removed, preserving the schedule's time continuity.

variants.title: Schedule Agenda List
variants.description: Day 1 agenda with keynote, two track sessions, a lunch break, and another track session, each with time/title/speaker/track badge.
accessibility: Track badges pair a text label with color to remain legible without color perception.

variants.title: Schedule Agenda List (Dark)
variants.description: The same day agenda adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Track badge and muted-break text contrast remain distinguishable at dark-surface contrast.
